evidence: Enumerated every value any criterion or prompt tells the judge to create and checked it against the seed (environment/assets/seed_data.json, byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json) and the reference initial state (db.js seedIfEmpty inserts only the seed; index.html and js/*.js). (1) Fixed literal probes: hro_messaging 'plain' is absent from every seed message, note and name (the only 'plain' hits are the seed generated_note prose 'explained' and the board.js dataTransfer MIME string 'text/plain', neither rendered content), including the fallback seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201, 3 messages). hro_pol_live_board example draft 'Call back on Fri' is absent from seed and markup and is an unsaved draft on the judge's own new card. Reference placeholders ('Reason for rejecting', board.js:21,216) are input placeholders, not values, and match no probe. (2) Judge-chosen probes are explicitly distinctive: functional prompt.md:21 'Use your own new jobs and cards ... (suffix every job title and candidate name for this session)'; functional prompt.md:29 and polish prompt.md:18 'Give every message, note or card created inside a timed action a unique suffix for this review so the watched text cannot match anything older'; gates (constraints judge.toml:25 'a unique name, a unique email address'; scored prompts 'unique name and email (add a short suffix for this review)'); hro_intake_restart suffixed rejection reason and Noor message; hro_activity suffixed reason; hro_candidate 'a reason ending in a unique suffix (search every candidate response for it)'; hro_two_people Mei's 'new suffixed card'; hro_long_thread Noor's 'suffixed message'; hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume 'distinctive' replies. The seed has 3 jobs (Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer) and 16 applications with ordinary full names, so suffixed J1/J2 titles and suffixed A-F, V-Z, A2 cards cannot pre-exist. (3) Mutation readbacks without a mandated suffix (internal notes, rejection reasons in hro_reject_reopen/hro_undo/hro_manager_roles, hro_drafts drafts, the two-line message) are read on the judge's own new job, cards and conversations, which neither the seed nor the reference start state can contain. Tomas's new card is distinguished from his seeded Data Analyst application by its new job and status sequence starting 'Not moving forward'. (4) Seeded facts the judge reads (hro_intake_restart Platform Engineer orders Greta/Ade/Marco and Priya/Samuel and Noor's note; hro_unread_seen Lena count 1; hro_candidate statuses; the 120-message thread) are baseline reads, not mutation proofs, and match the seed (APP-105/106/108 Applied 1-3; APP-103/104 Screen 1-2; notes[0] 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; reads USR-CAN3 read_count 2 of APP-301's 3 messages gives 1 unread). Relative reads are required where shared state can drift (prompt.md:21 'never rely on a starting count'; hro_long_thread 'read counts relative to what it holds'). Lessons file checked for every bearing instance: lesson 15 (restart re-reads several exact records) - hro_intake_restart records jobs, per-stage order, F's suffixed reason, a note, a suffixed message, unread total and Activity lines before restart_app; all sit on new jobs or carry a suffix, so none can be satisfied by seed data surviving or being reloaded (reseeding is separately caught by 'seeded jobs appear once'). Lessons 7/14 (visible marker in timed steps) - every timed watch looks for suffixed text, so a pre-existing match cannot yield met=true. Other lessons do not bear on this row. Weak-app trial: a static or seed-copy app shows only seed records, so it cannot display any suffixed job, card, reason or message, nor 'plain'; no mutation leg passes from pre-existing data. Conforming-alternative trial: an app that escapes HTML, stores drafts server-side, or refuses duplicate job titles collides with no seed or reference value, since the seed holds no J1/J2 titles and no probe literal. Manual application of check-probe-not-in-seed: zero hits. This is a source review; no configured judge run was needed or is claimed for this row.
notes: Non-blocking: rejection reasons in hro_reject_reopen, hro_undo and hro_manager_roles are not required to carry a suffix; they live on new cards so they cannot be pre-satisfied by seed or reference, but suffixing them as hro_activity and hro_intake_restart do would make the 'reason is gone after reopening' read unambiguous. Cross-session suffix reuse outside timed actions depends on the judge picking a new suffix per session; that is a shared-state concern for row 37, not seed or reference pre-satisfaction.
